# NexNet v0.21.0: full change log

Every pull request merged for v0.21.0, grouped by work unit. Most were merged into the `train/multilang` branch; the ones marked *(master)* were merged into `master` first and then synced into the train. The [release notes](release-notes-v0.21.0.md) explain what changed and whether you need to act.

204 pull requests: 193 into `train/multilang`, 11 into `master`.
